brief: My wellness stack — 5 things that actually moved the needle.

slots.headline: What Actually Works?
slots.subtitle: 5 habits that changed my energy, sleep, and focus for good.

slots.title: Morning Sunlight First
slots.body: Ten minutes within an hour of waking. No phone, no sunglasses, just sky. It anchors your cortisol and sets your circadian clock for better sleep tonight.

slots.title: Magnesium Before Bed
slots.body: Not all forms are equal. I use glycinate for calm and sleep depth. It's the one supplement I notice when I skip it.

slots.title: Protein At Every Meal
slots.body: Aiming for 30g within 30 minutes of waking stabilized my energy. No more 11am crashes or ravenous late-night snacking.

slots.title: Walking After Eating
slots.body: A ten-minute post-meal walk flattens glucose spikes better than any hack. It's free, quiet time that doubles as digestion support.

slots.title: Digital Sunset Hour
slots.body: Screens off by 9pm. Amber lights and a book replace the scroll. My sleep latency dropped from forty minutes to under ten.

slots.title: Stack Them Together
slots.body: These five aren't fancy. They're consistent. The magic is in the synergy: light, minerals, movement, food, and rest working as one system.
